evidence.summary: Method A reduced the median error under the matched evaluation protocol.
Method B showed a smaller improvement after a different preprocessing step.

claims.text: Method A reduced median error by 12% under the matched protocol.
The apparent advantage changes when preprocessing and evaluation conditions differ.

agreements: Both studies report directionally lower error after the intervention.
conflicts: The reported magnitude differs across preprocessing protocols.
syntheses.conflict_assessment: The difference is plausibly methodological; the evidence does not support a protocol-independent ranking.
syntheses.boundary: The comparison is limited to studies using the same error definition and comparable dataset splits.

paragraph_contracts.job: Compare the two evaluations and bound the resulting conclusion.
paragraph_contracts.transition: This boundary motivates a condition-matched comparison.

revision_items.action: Replaced an unconditional ranking with a condition-bounded comparison.
